29
諸禁軍名額系捧日、天武、龍衛、神衛爲上軍，五百文已上料錢見錢爲中軍，不滿五百文料錢見錢並捧日天武第五第七軍、龍衛神衛第十軍、驍猛、雄勇、驍雄、雄威爲下軍。 元豐五年十月，詔諸路教閱廂軍，於下禁軍內增入指揮名額，排連並同禁軍。 蓋熙寧之籍，天下禁軍凡五十六萬八千六百八十八人； 元豐之籍，六十一萬二千二百四十三人。
Among Palace Corps titles and quotas, Sun-Holding, Heavenly Martial, Dragon Guard, and Divine Guard ranked as upper armies; units paid five hundred cash or more in grain-pay cash counted as middle armies; units paid less than five hundred cash, together with Sun-Holding and Heavenly Martial Fifth and Seventh Armies, Dragon Guard and Divine Guard Tenth Armies, Fierce Bold, Bold Courage, Fierce Bold, and Bold Prestige, ranked as lower armies. In the tenth month of Yuanfeng 5, an edict ordered training-review Comforter Corps in every route to take command titles and quotas from lower Palace Corps ranks, with company and platoon organization matching Palace Corps. Under the Xining registry, Palace Corps empire-wide totaled 568,688; under the Yuanfeng registry, 612,243.
30
紹聖四年，陝西路增置蕃落馬軍。 是年，蘭州金城置步軍保捷、馬軍蕃落。
In Shaosheng 4, the Shaanxi route added Tribal Frontier mounted troops. That same year, at Jincheng in Lanzhou, Foot Secure Swift and Mounted Tribal Frontier were established.
31
元符元年，利州路興元府、閬州各增置就糧武寧； 又湖北、江東各增置有馬雄略。 涇原路新築南牟會，賜名西安州，戍守共以七千人爲額，仍招置馬軍蕃落、步軍保捷。 天都、臨羌砦戍守各以三千人爲額，仍各置馬軍蕃落、步軍保捷。 永興軍等路創置蕃落； 河北大名府等二十二州共創置馬軍廣威、步軍保捷，以河北大水，招刺流民故也。
In Yuanfu 1, Xingyuan Prefecture and Lang Prefecture in Lizhou route each added Grain-Pay Martial Tranquility; Hubei and Jiangdong each also added Mounted Bold Strategy. On the Jingyuan route Nanmouhui was newly fortified and named Xi'an Prefecture; garrison strength was fixed at seven thousand, with Mounted Tribal Frontier and Foot Secure Swift recruited. Garrisons at Tiandu and Linqiang stockades were each fixed at three thousand, with Mounted Tribal Frontier and Foot Secure Swift established at each. Yongxing Army and other routes newly established Tribal Frontier; twenty-two prefectures including Daming Prefecture in Hebei jointly raised Mounted Broad Awesome and Foot Secure Swift, to recruit displaced people after the great Hebei flood.
32
二年正月，環慶增置敢勇二百人。 四月，環慶路都總管司言：「本路新展定邊城，比之橫山、興平等處城砦尤深，乞增置住營馬軍蕃落、步軍保捷。 」六月，環慶路都總管司言：「展築慶州白豹城，合增置住營馬步軍。 」又鄜延路都總管司言：「本路新築米脂等八堡砦，合增置土兵、馬步軍。 」皆從之。 三年，樞密院奏：「河北增置馬軍廣威、步軍保捷二萬餘人，欲令揀選升換在京闕額軍分。 」從之。 自紹聖以來，陝西、河東連用兵六年，進築未已，覆軍殺將，供給不可勝紀。
In the eleventh month of the second year, Huanqing added two hundred Bold Courage troops. In the fourth month, the Huanqing Route Overall Command reported: "This route has newly expanded Dingbian city; compared with stockades such as Hengshan and Xingping it is especially deep—we ask to add stationed Mounted Tribal Frontier and Foot Secure Swift. " In the sixth month, the Huanqing Route Overall Command reported: "Expanding Baibao city in Qing Prefecture requires adding stationed mounted and foot troops. " The Fuyan Route Overall Command also reported: "This route has newly built eight forts and stockades including Mizhi; local militia plus mounted and foot troops should be added. " All were approved. In the third year, the Bureau of Military Affairs memorialized: "Hebei has added more than twenty thousand Mounted Broad Awesome and Foot Secure Swift; we propose selecting them for transfer to fill vacant Palace Corps slots in the capital. " Approval was given. Since Shaosheng, Shaanxi and Hedong had fought continuously for six years; forward fortification never stopped; armies were wiped out and generals killed; supplies poured out beyond reckoning.
33
四年十一月，廣西路置刀牌手三千人，於切要州軍更戌，以寧海名。 十二月，詔：「四輔屏翰京師，兵力不可偏重，可各以二萬人爲額。 」五年，環慶路進築徐丁台城，賜名安邊，置馬軍蕃落、步軍保捷。
In the eleventh month of the fourth year, the Guangxi route raised three thousand blade-shield troops, rotating garrison at critical prefectures and armies, under the name Secure the Sea. In the twelfth month, an edict: "The four auxiliary prefectures that screen the capital must not be over-heavy in troops; each may be fixed at twenty thousand as quota. " In the fifth year, the Huanqing route forward-built Xudingtai city, named it Secure the Border, and established Mounted Tribal Frontier and Foot Secure Swift.
34
靖康元年，詔； 「廣西宜、融二州實爲極邊，舊置馬軍難議減省，且依元降指揮招置。」
In Jingkang 1, an edict: "Yi and Rong prefectures in Guangxi stand on the outermost frontier; the mounted troops formerly established there cannot easily be cut—we shall recruit according to the original edict."
35
自元豐而後，民兵日盛，募兵日衰，其募兵闕額，則收其廩給，以爲民兵教閱之費。 元祐以降，民兵亦衰。 崇甯、大觀以來，蔡京用事，兵弊日滋，至於受逃亡，收配隸，猶恐不足。 政和之後，久廢蒐補，軍士死亡之余，老疾者徒費廩給，少健者又多冗占，階級既壞，紀律遂亡。 童貫握兵，勢傾內外，凡遇陣敗，恥於人言，第申逃竄。 河北將兵，十無二三，往往多住招闕額，以其封樁爲上供之用。 陝右諸路兵亦無幾，種師道將兵入援，止得萬五千人。 故靖康之變，雖畫一之詔，哀痛激切，而事已無及矣。
After Yuanfeng, local militia grew daily while recruited troops declined; when recruited quotas fell short, their grain pay was diverted to fund local militia training. From Yuanyou onward, local militia declined as well. Since Chongning and Daguan, with Cai Jing in power, military abuses worsened by the day; even taking deserters and enrolled convicts, they still feared the ranks were not full enough. After Zhenghe, recruitment and replacement had long been neglected; among the dead and the living alike, the old and sick wasted grain pay while the young and strong mostly held phantom posts; ranks collapsed and discipline died. Tong Guan held the army, his power overwhelming court and camp alike; whenever a battle was lost, too ashamed to admit defeat, he would report only flight and dispersal. Hebei commander troops were scarcely two or three in ten; many quotas were deliberately left vacant, their earmarked funds diverted as tribute to the capital. Troops in the Shaanxi routes were also few; when Zhong Shidao marched to reinforce the capital, he mustered only fifteen thousand. Thus when the Jingkang crisis came, though a uniform edict went out, anguished and urgent, it was already too late.
36
高宗南渡，始建御營司，未幾，復並御營歸樞密院。 建炎四年，改御前五軍爲神武軍，御營五軍爲神武副軍，並隸樞密院。 五年，上以祖宗故事，兵皆隸三衙，乃廢神武中軍隸殿前司，於是殿司兵柄始一。 乾道元年，詔殿前兵馬權以七萬三千人爲額。
After Gaozong crossed south, he first established the Imperial Camp Bureau; before long he merged the Imperial Camp back into the Bureau of Military Affairs. In Jianyan 4, the five Imperial Front armies became Divine Martial Army, and the five Imperial Camp armies Divine Martial Auxiliary Army, both under the Bureau of Military Affairs. In the fifth year, citing ancestral precedent that all troops belonged to the three yamen, the emperor abolished the independent Divine Martial Central Army and brought it under the Palace Front Bureau; at last the Palace Front Bureau held unified military authority. In Qiandao 1, an edict provisionally fixed Palace Front horse and foot at seventy-three thousand.
37
諸屯駐大軍則皆諸將之部曲，高宗開元帥府，諸將兵悉隸焉。 建炎後，諸大將兵浸盛，因時制變，屯無常所。 如劉光世軍或在鎮江、池州、太平，韓世忠軍或屯江州、江陰，岳飛一軍或屯宜興、蔣山，王彥八字軍隨張浚入蜀，吳玠兵多屯鳳州、大散關、和尚原。 是時合內外大軍十九萬四千餘，川、陝不與焉。 及楊沂中將中軍總宿衛，江東劉光世、淮東韓世忠、湖北岳飛、湖南王𤫉四軍共十九萬一千六百，亦未嘗有屯。
The various garrisoned great armies were all the personal followings of individual generals; Gaozong opened a marshal headquarters, and every general's troops fell under it. After Jianyan, the great generals' armies gradually swelled; adapting to the times, they had no fixed garrison. Liu Guangshi's army might be at Zhenjiang, Chizhou, or Taiping; Han Shizhong's at Jiangzhou or Jiangyin; Yue Fei's at Yixing or Jiangshan; Wang Yan's Eight-Character Army followed Zhang Jun into Shu; Wu Jie's troops mostly garrisoned Feng Prefecture, Dasanguan, and Heshang Plain. At that time, inner and outer great armies combined exceeded 194,000; Sichuan and Shaanxi were not included. When Yang Yizhong commanded the central army overseeing palace guard duty, Liu Guangshi in Jiangdong, Han Shizhong in Huai East, Yue Fei in Hubei, and Wang Yan in Hunan—the four armies totaled 191,600, and none had fixed garrisons.
38
紹興十一年，范同以諸將握兵難制，獻謀秦檜，且以柘皋之捷言於上，召張俊、韓世忠、岳飛入覲，張俊首納所部兵。 分命三大帥副校各統所部，自爲一軍，更銜曰統制御前軍馬。 罷宣撫司，遇出師取旨，兵皆隸樞密院，屯駐仍舊。 而四川大將兵曰興、成、階、鳳、文、龍、利、閬、金、洋、綿、房、西和州、大安軍、興元、隆慶、潼川府凡十七郡，亦分屯就糧焉。
In Shaoxing 11, Fan Tong, finding the generals' hold on troops hard to control, advised Qin Hui and also told the emperor of the victory at Zhegao; Zhang Jun, Han Shizhong, and Yue Fei were summoned to court, and Zhang Jun was first to surrender his troops. Deputy commanders of the three great marshals were each ordered to lead their own followers as separate armies, bearing the new title Controller of Imperial Front Horse and Foot. The Pacification Commissions were abolished; on campaign, orders came from court, all troops belonged to the Bureau of Military Affairs, and garrisons stayed as they were. Sichuan's great general armies garrisoned grain-pay across seventeen prefectures: Xing, Cheng, Jie, Feng, Wen, Long, Li, Lang, Jin, Yang, Mian, Fang, Xihe Prefecture, Da'an Army, Xingyuan, Longqing, and Tongchuan Prefecture.
39
乾道之末，各州有都統司領兵：建康五萬，池州一萬二千，鎮江四萬七千，楚州武鋒軍一萬一千，鄂州四萬九千，荊南二萬，興元一萬七千，金州一萬一千。 其後分屯列戍，增損靡常。 所可考者，統制、統領、正將、副將、準備將之目也。
At the end of Qiandao, overall command offices in each prefecture led troops: Jiankang 50,000, Chizhou 12,000, Zhenjiang 47,000, Chuzhou Martial Edge Army 11,000, E Prefecture 49,000, Jingnan 20,000, Xingyuan 17,000, Jin Prefecture 11,000. Afterward, dispersed garrisons and frontier posts waxed and waned without fixed rule. What can be verified are the titles Controller, Commanding General, Senior Commander, Deputy Commander, and Reserve Commander.
40
至於水軍之制，則有加于前者，南渡以後，江、淮皆爲邊境故也。 建炎初，李綱請於沿江、淮、河帥府置水兵二軍，要郡別置水兵一軍，次要郡別置中軍，招善舟楫者充，立軍號曰淩波、樓船軍。 其戰艦則有海鰍、水哨馬、雙車、得勝、十棹、大飛、旗捷、防沙、平底、水飛馬之名。 隆興以後至於寶祐、景定間，江、淮沿流堡隘相望，守禦益繁，民勞益甚。 迨鹹淳末，廣東籍蜑丁，閩海拘舶船民船，公私俱弊矣。
The navy system exceeded what had gone before, for after the southern crossing the Yangtze and Huai had become frontiers. At the beginning of Jianyan, Li Gang asked that along the Yangtze, Huai, and Yellow River command headquarters raise two naval armies, key prefectures one naval army each, secondary prefectures one central army each, recruiting skilled boatmen under the names Wave-Cleaving and Tower-Ship Army. Their warships bore the names Sea Porpoise, Water Scout Horse, Twin Cart, Victor, Ten Oars, Great Flyer, Banner Swift, Sand Guard, Flat Bottom, and Water Flying Horse. From Longxing onward through Baoyou and Jingding, fortresses and passes lined the Yangtze and Huai currents; defense grew ever more elaborate and the people's burdens ever heavier. By the end of Xianchun, Guangdong registered Tanka boat people and Minhai conscripted merchant and civilian vessels—public and private alike were ruined.
41
其禁軍將校，則有殿前司都指揮使、副都指揮使、都虞候各一人； 諸班有都虞候、指揮使、都知、副都知、押班； 御龍諸直有四直都虞候，本直各有都虞候、指揮使、副指揮使、都頭、副都頭、十將、將虞候； 馬步軍有捧日、天武左右四廂都指揮使，捧日、天武左右各有都指揮使，每軍有都指揮使、都虞候，每指揮有指揮使、副指揮使，每都有軍使、步軍謂之都頭。
Palace Corps commanders included one Palace Front Bureau Overall Commander, one Deputy Overall Commander, and one Chief Adjutant each; squads had Chief Adjutant, Commander, Director, Deputy Director, and Squad Leader; Imperial Dragon direct squads had four direct Chief Adjutants; each direct squad had Chief Adjutant, Commander, Deputy Commander, Squad Head, Deputy Squad Head, Ten-Captain, and Captain Adjutant; mounted and foot armies had Sun-Holding and Heavenly Martial left and right four-wing Overall Commanders; Sun-Holding and Heavenly Martial left and right each had Overall Commanders; each army had Overall Commander and Chief Adjutant; each command had Commander and Deputy Commander; each company had Army Commissioner—in infantry called Squad Head.
42
副兵馬使、步軍謂之副都頭。
Deputy Army Commissioner—in infantry called Deputy Squad Head.
43
十將、將虞候、承局、押官。
Ten-Captain, Captain Adjutant, Clerk, and Escort Officer.
44
所領諸班直、指揮，騎兵、步兵之額敘列如左。 以其前後之異同者分爲建隆以來之制、熙寧以後之制，而將兵、水兵之制可考者，因附著於後雲。
The cavalry and infantry quotas of the various squad-direct commands and units are set forth below. Because earlier and later arrangements differ, they are divided into the system since Jianlong and the system after Xining; verifiable arrangements for commander troops and naval troops are appended afterward.
45
建隆以來之制
The system since Jianlong
46
殿前指揮使左右班二。 宋初，以舊府親從帶甲之士及諸班軍騎中選武藝絕倫者充。
Palace Front Commander left and right squads, two. At the founding of Song, men were chosen from the old headquarters' armored personal followers and from various squad cavalries for unmatched martial skill.
47
內殿直左右班四。 周制，簡軍校暨武臣子弟有材勇者立。 又有川班內殿直，乾德三年平蜀得奇兵，簡閱材貌魁偉便習騎射者凡百二十人立，開寶四年廢。
Inner Hall Direct left and right squads, four. Under the Zhou system, established by selecting military officers and martial sons of officials with talent and courage. There was also Sichuan Squad Inner Hall Direct: in Qiande 3, after pacifying Shu, exceptional troops were taken; one hundred twenty men of imposing build skilled in mounted archery were selected and established; abolished in Kaibao 4.
48
散員左右班四。 周制，招置諸州豪傑立，散指揮、散都頭、散祗候凡十二班。 又於北面驍捷員僚直及諸軍內簡閱填補。 咸平五年，定州路都部署王超言； 「緣邊有強梁輩常居四界，擾動邊境，請厚給金帛募充散員。 」從之。
Loose Members left and right squads, four. Under the Zhou system, established by recruiting heroes from the various prefectures; Loose Commands, Loose Squad Leaders, and Loose Attendants totaled twelve squads. Men were also selected from the Northern Fierce Swift Officer Direct and from among the various armies to fill vacancies. In Xianping 5, Dingzhou Route Overall Deployment Wang Chao memorialized; "On the frontier there are strongmen who constantly dwell in the border zones and disturb the frontier—we ask to recruit them generously with gold and silk as Loose Members. " Approval was given.
49
散指揮左右班四。
Loose Commands left and right squads, four.
50
散都頭左右班二。
Loose Squad Leaders left and right squads, two.
51
金槍班左右班二，舊名內直。 太平興國初，改選諸軍中善用槍槊者補之。
Golden Spear squads left and right, two; formerly called Inner Direct. At the beginning of Taiping Xingguo, men skilled with spear and halberd were selected from the various armies to fill them.
52
東西班弩手、龍旗直、招箭班共十二，舊號東西班承旨。 淳化二年，改爲殿前侍，東西各第一第二弩手、龍旗直班六，並帶甲，選諸班及不帶甲班增補。 其東第二茶酒及第三、西第四班不帶甲，並以諸軍員、使臣及沒王事者子弟爲之。 又擇善弓箭者爲招箭班。
East and West Squad crossbowmen, Dragon Banner Direct, and Arrow Summons Squad totaled twelve; formerly called East and West Squad Attendants. In Chunhua 2, the unit became Palace Front Attendants: six armored squads—east and west first and second crossbowmen plus Dragon Banner Direct—filled from other squads and unarmored squads. The east second Tea-and-Wine and third squads and the west fourth squad wore no armor; their ranks came from army officers' sons, envoys' sons, and sons of men who had died in imperial service. Skilled archers were also chosen for the Arrow Summons Squad.
53
散直左右班四。 雍熙四年，以諸道募置藩鎮廳頭軍將及詣登聞院求試武藝者立。 咸平元年，選諸節度使從人、騎御馬小底增補。
Loose Direct left and right squads, four. In Yongxi 4, it was established from frontier hall-head officers recruited on the circuits and from men who petitioned at the Direct Petition Court to test their martial skill. In Xianping 1, vacancies were filled from military commissioners' attendants and Imperial Mount Junior Attendants.
54
鈞容直班二。 太平興國三年，選諸軍諳曉音樂、騎御馬小底立。 淳化二年，改之。
Imperial Procession Direct squads, two. In Taiping Xingguo 3, it was established from troops in various armies who knew music and from Imperial Mount Junior Attendants. In Chunhua 2, it was reorganized.
55
外殿直班一。 諸班衛士中年多者號看班外殿直，後削看班之號。 或詣諸道攝軍校之職部分州兵，謂之權管。 國初又有內員僚直，開寶中廢。 太平興國四年，征太原，得上軍。 天禧四年，併入此班。
Outer Hall Direct squad, one. Older squad guards were called Watch-Squad Outer Hall Direct; later the Watch-Squad title was dropped. Some were sent to circuits to serve temporarily as military officers and take charge of prefectural troops—called Provisional Command. At the dynasty's founding there was also Inner Officer Direct; it was abolished under Kaibao. In Taiping Xingguo 4, campaigning against Taiyuan, superior troops were obtained. In Tianxi 4, it was merged into this squad.
56
捧日並左射、钅屈直、弩手、左第五軍，總指揮三十五。 京師三十三，雍丘、鄭各一。 舊號小底，周改爲鐵騎，太平興國二年改爲日騎，雍熙四年改今名。 分左、右廂，各四軍。 雍熙三年，選善槍槊者充钅屈直。 淳化三年，選善左射者爲左射。 咸平五年，選天武、拱聖、驍騎善弩射者爲弩手。
Sun-Holding, Left Shooter, Bent Bow Direct, crossbowmen, and Left Fifth Army—thirty-five commands in all. Thirty-three at the capital; one each at Yongqiu and Zheng. Formerly Junior Attendants; under Zhou renamed Iron Cavalry; in Taiping Xingguo 2 Sun Cavalry; in Yongxi 4 given its present name. It was divided into left and right wings of four armies each. In Yongxi 3, skilled spearmen were chosen for Bent Bow Direct. In Chunhua 3, skilled left shooters were chosen for Left Shooter. In Xianping 5, skilled crossbowmen were drawn from Heavenly Martial, Bowing to the Stars, and Fierce Cavalry.
57
契丹直三。 咸平、許、壽各一。 後唐置，旋廢。 開寶三年，以遼人內附之衆復置。 太平興國中，因事復置，旋廢。
Khitan Direct, three. One each at Xianping, Xu, and Shou. Established under Later Tang and soon abolished. In Kaibao 3, it was re-established with Liao subjects who had defected inward. During Taiping Xingguo it was briefly re-established, then abolished again.
58
歸明渤海指揮二。 京師。 太平興國四年，征幽州，以渤海降兵立。
Surrendered Ming Bohai commands, two. At the capital. In Taiping Xingguo 4, campaigning against Youzhou, it was established from surrendered Bohai troops.
59
拱聖指揮二十一。 京師。 乾德中，選諸州騎兵送闕下，立爲驍雄，後改驍猛。 雍熙四年，又改拱辰。 未幾改今名。
Bowing to the Stars commands, twenty-one. At the capital. During Qiande, prefectural cavalry sent to court formed Fierce Bold; later renamed Fierce Fierce. In Yongxi 4, it was renamed again Bowing to the Stars. Soon afterward it received its present name.
60
吐渾小底舊指揮五，治平中並爲二。 京師。 太平興國四年，平太原，獲吐渾子弟，又選監牧諸軍中所有者充。
Tujue Junior Attendants formerly had five commands; in the Zhiping era they were merged into two. At the capital. In Taiping Xingguo 4, after the pacification of Taiyuan, Tujue youths were taken in; men from pasture-supervision armies were also selected to fill the ranks.
61
驍騎指揮二十三。 京師。 太平興國四年置，後又選掉搨索兵及左右教駿兵增置。 雍熙四年，改殿前司步鬥弩手爲驍騎弩手。 淳化四年，選壯勇超絕者爲上驍騎，在本軍之上。 咸平五年，分左、右廂。 舊又有殿前小底。 至道二年，選驍騎馬直及善射者充，後廢。
Fierce Cavalry commands, twenty-three. At the capital. Established in Taiping Xingguo 4; later expanded by drawing on Rope Handler troops and the Left and Right Training Steeds. In Yongxi 4, the Palace Front Bureau's Foot Combat crossbowmen became Fierce Cavalry crossbowmen. In Chunhua 4, the strongest and boldest were chosen as Upper Fierce Cavalry, ranking above the main force. In Xianping 5, it was split into left and right wings. There had also been Palace Front Junior Attendants. In Zhidao 2, it was filled from Fierce Cavalry Horse Direct and skilled archers; later abolished.
62
驍勝左右指揮各五。 京師。 咸平三年，選教駿、驍騎諸軍備征子弟材勇者立。
Fierce Victory left and right commands, five each. At the capital. In Xianping 3, it was established from talented, courageous sons of Training Steeds and Fierce Cavalry Campaign Ready troops.
63
甯朔指揮十。 京師、尉氏各三，雍丘、渭、河陽、河陰各一。 咸平三年，選教駿諸軍備征及外州兵立。
Secure the North commands, ten. Three each at the capital and Weishi; one each at Yongqiu, Wei, Heyang, and Heyin. In Xianping 3, it was established from Training Steeds Campaign Ready troops and troops from outlying prefectures.
64
龍猛指揮八。 京師。 太平興國中，揀閱龍騎及諸州部送招獲群盜，取其材勇者立。 淳化四年，又擇精悍者爲教閱龍猛以備禽盜，在本軍之上。 景德四年，又選龍騎、驍騎兵增之。
Dragon Fierce commands, eight. At the capital. During Taiping Xingguo, Dragon Cavalry and captured bandits escorted from the prefectures were reviewed, and the ablest and boldest were chosen to form the unit. In Chunhua 4, picked elite formed Training-Review Dragon Fierce to hunt bandits, ranking above the main force. In Jingde 4, Dragon Cavalry and Fierce Cavalry troops were added to enlarge it.
65
飛猛指揮二。 咸平二年，選龍猛、驍騎兵子弟之材勇者立。
Flying Fierce commands, two. In Xianping 2, it was established from talented, courageous sons of Dragon Fierce and Fierce Cavalry troops.
66
驍猛指揮四。 尉氏三、太康一。 舊號驍雄，太平興國中改。 雍熙四年，以拱聖年多者爲拱辰軍，其次等者如故。 景德四年，以拱聖年多者隸之。
Fierce Bold commands, four. Three at Weishi, one at Taikang. Formerly Fierce Bold; renamed during Taiping Xingguo. In Yongxi 4, the oldest Bowing to the Stars troops became Bowing to the Stars Army; those of the next grade stayed where they were. In Jingde 4, the oldest Bowing to the Stars troops were transferred to it.
67
神騎指揮十八。 雍丘十三，咸平五。 端拱二年，選驍雄新配人及教駿、借事等兵立。 淳化二年，廢掉搨索軍隸之。 咸平二年，又擇教駿、備征及外州增之。
Divine Cavalry commands, eighteen. Thirteen at Yongqiu, five at Xianping. In Duangong 2, it was established from newly assigned Fierce Bold men plus Training Steeds, Temporary Duty, and other troops. In Chunhua 2, the Rope Handler army was abolished and absorbed into it. In Xianping 2, more men were added from Training Steeds, Campaign Ready, and outlying prefectures.
68
驍雄指揮四。 咸平、陳留各二。 太平興國八年，遷驍猛中次等者立。 景德中，以驍騎、驍勝、寧朔軍年多者隸之。
Fierce Bold commands, four. Two each at Xianping and Chenliu. In Taiping Xingguo 8, second-grade men from Fierce Bold were transferred to form it. During Jingde, the oldest troops from Fierce Cavalry, Fierce Victory, and Secure the North were assigned to it.
69
吐渾直指揮三。 太原二，潞一。 太平興國八年，太原遷雲州及河界吐渾立，屯並、代州。 雍熙三年，又得雲、朔歸明吐渾增立，屯潞州。
Tujue Direct commands, three. Two at Taiyuan, one at Lu. In Taiping Xingguo 8, it was formed from Tujue relocated from Taiyuan, Yun Prefecture, and the Yellow River frontier and garrisoned at Bing and Dai. In Yongxi 3, more surrendered Ming Tujue from Yun and Shuo were added; the unit was garrisoned at Lu Prefecture.
70
安慶直四。 太原一，潞三。 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔及河東歸明安慶民分屯並、潞等州，給以土田。 雍熙四年立。
Secure Celebration Direct, four. One at Taiyuan, three at Lu. In Taiping Xingguo 4, surrendered Ming Secure Celebration people from Yun, Shuo, and Hedong were resettled at Bing, Lu, and other prefectures and given land. Established in Yongxi 4.
71
三部落指揮一。 太原。 太平興國四年，親征幽州，遷雲、朔、應等州部落於并州，因立。
Three Tribes commands, one. At Taiyuan. In Taiping Xingguo 4, on the emperor's campaign against Youzhou, tribes from Yun, Shuo, Ying, and other prefectures were moved to Bing Prefecture and the command was established.
72
清朔指揮四。 西京二，許、汝各一。 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔州民於內地，得自置馬以爲騎兵，謂之家戶馬。 雍熙四年立。
Clear North commands, four. Two at the Western Capital; one each at Xu and Ru. In Taiping Xingguo 4, people from Yun and Shuo were resettled inland, allowed to supply their own horses as cavalry—these were called Household Horse troops. Established in Yongxi 4.
73
擒戎指揮五。 西京、許各二，汝一。 太平興國四年，遷雲、朔州民於西京、許汝等州，給以土田，充家戶馬。 端拱二年立。
Capture Barbarians commands, five. Two each at the Western Capital and Xu; one at Ru. In Taiping Xingguo 4, people from Yun and Shuo were resettled at the Western Capital, Xu, Ru, and other prefectures, given land, and enrolled as Household Horse troops. Established in Duangong 2.
74
新安內員僚直五。 端拱二年，成德軍節度使田重進言； 「易州靜砦兵先屯鎮州，賊陷勇陷穀，盡俘其家，請以其軍備宿衛。 」因而立此直。 後廢，天聖後無。
Xin'an Inner Officer Direct, five. In Duangong 2, Chengde Army Military Commissioner Tian Chongjin memorialized; "The Jingzhai troops of Yi Prefecture had been posted at Zhen Prefecture; when bandits seized Yongxiangu they captured every man's family. We ask that this army be kept as palace guard reserve. " The Direct was established on that basis. It was later abolished and did not exist after Tiansheng.
75
散祗候左右班二。 天聖前無。
Loose Attendants left and right squads, two. It did not exist before Tiansheng.
76
步鬥指揮六。 尉氏、太康各一，蔡四。 慶曆中增置，天聖前無。
Foot Combat commands, six. One command each at Weishi and Taikang; four at Cai. These were added during the Qingli era; before Tiansheng there were none.
77
御龍直左右二。 舊號簇御馬直，太平興國二年改爲簇御龍直，後改今名。
Imperial Dragon Direct: two commands, left and right. Formerly Clustered Imperial Horse Direct; in Taiping Xingguo 2 renamed Clustered Imperial Dragon Direct, and later given its present name.
78
御龍骨朵子直左右二。 舊號骨䤪子直，太平興國二年改爲御龍散手直，後改今名。
Imperial Dragon Mace Direct: two commands, left and right. Formerly Bone Mace Direct; in Taiping Xingguo 2 renamed Imperial Dragon Loose-Hand Direct, and later given its present name.
79
御龍弓箭直五。 選天武諸軍材貌魁傑者充。
Imperial Dragon Bow Direct: five commands. Filled from the Heavenly Martial armies with men of outstanding build and bearing.
80
御龍弩直五。
Imperial Dragon Crossbow Direct: five commands.
81
天武並寬衣、钅屈直、左射，總指揮三十四。 京師三十三，咸平一。
Heavenly Martial together with Loose-Robe, Bent Bow Direct, and Left Shooter units: thirty-four commands in all. Thirty-three in the capital and one at Xianping.
82
神勇上下共二十一指揮。 乾德中，揀閱諸軍壯實而大體者立爲雄威。 太平興國二年，改爲雄勇。 雍熙四年改今名。 淳化四年，選武藝超絕者立爲上神勇，以備擒盜。
Divine Courage, upper and lower ranks: twenty-one commands in all. In Qiande, the sturdiest and largest men from the various armies were reviewed and formed into Bold Prestige. In Taiping Xingguo 2 it was renamed Bold Courage. In Yongxi 4 it received its present name, Divine Courage. In Chunhua 4, men of surpassing martial skill were chosen to form Upper Divine Courage, a unit kept ready to hunt down bandits.
83
宣武上下共二十指揮。 京師。 太平興國二年，並效節、忠猛二軍立，又選諸軍及鄉兵增之。 至道二年，又選軍頭司步直善用槍槊掉刀者立殿前步直，後廢。
Xuanwu, upper and lower ranks: twenty commands in all. Stationed in the capital. In Taiping Xingguo 2 it was raised together with the Render Obedience and Loyal Fierce armies, then augmented with picks from other armies and the Local Militia. In Zhidao 2, spear-, halberd-, and dao-men from the Army Head Bureau foot direct were chosen to form Palace Front Foot Direct; the unit was later abolished.
84
虎翼太平興國中，揀雄武弩手立爲上鐵林，又于雄武、定遠、寧勝床子弩手、飛山雄武等軍選勁兵以增其數。 雍熙四年，改分左右四軍。 淳化四年，選本軍精銳者爲上虎翼，以備禽盜。 咸平二年，並廣勇軍隸之。 大中祥符六年，詔在京諸軍選江、淮士卒善水者習戰于金明池，立爲虎翼水軍。 舊指揮六十二，景德中增六。 京師。
Tiger Wing: during Taiping Xingguo, Bold Martial crossbowmen were formed into Upper Iron Forest, and crack troops were drawn from Bold Martial, Secure Distance, Secure Victory bed-frame crossbow units, Flying Mountain Bold Martial, and other commands to swell its ranks. In Yongxi 4 it was split into left and right wings, four armies in all. In Chunhua 4, the army's best men were picked for Upper Tiger Wing, kept ready to hunt down bandits. In Xianping 2 the Broad Courage army was absorbed into it. In Dazhong Xiangfu 6, an edict directed capital units to choose Yangtze-Huai men skilled on the water, drill them at Jinming Pool, and form Tiger Wing Navy. It had formerly numbered sixty-two commands; six were added in the Jingde era. Stationed in the capital.
85
雄勇舊號雄威，太平興國二年改今名。 雍熙四年，改神勇，復於本軍選退入次等者爲之。 舊指揮五，至和五年增爲八。 咸平三，鄆二，許、鄭、滑各一。
Bold Courage had formerly been Bold Prestige; in Taiping Xingguo 2 it received its present name. In Yongxi 4 it was renamed Divine Courage, and men who had slipped to second rank within the army were chosen again to fill it. It had formerly stood at five commands; in Zhihe 5 the total rose to eight. Three at Xianping; two at Yun; one each at Xu, Zheng, and Hua.
86
廣德開寶四年，平廣南，以其兵隸殿前司，次等隸八作司，闕則選廣南諸州兵補之。 雍熙三年，選八作司之強壯者爲揀中。 總指揮十。 咸平、尉氏、陽武、河陽、滄、鞏、白波各一，西京三。
Broad Virtue: in Kaibao 4, after Guangnan was pacified, its troops entered the Palace Front Bureau, second-tier men went to the Eight Works Bureau, and gaps were filled from Guangnan prefectural forces. In Yongxi 3, the strongest men in the Eight Works Bureau were chosen for Selected Broad Virtue. Ten commands in all. One command each at Xianping, Weishi, Yangwu, Heyang, Cang, Gong, and Baibo; three at the Western Capital.
87
廣勇淳化二年，選神射、鞭箭、雄武、效忠等軍強壯善射者立爲廣武，大中祥符二年改今名。 舊指揮二十三，慶曆中增爲四十三，每指揮十爲一軍。 京師五，陳留二十二，咸平、東明、太原、胙城、南京各二，襄邑、陽武、鄆各一，滑三。
Broad Courage: in Chunhua 2, strong bowmen were taken from Divine Archer, Whip Arrow, Bold Martial, Render Loyalty, and other units to form Broad Martial; in Dazhong Xiangfu 2 it received its present name. It had formerly numbered twenty-three commands; in Qingli the total rose to forty-three, with every ten commands grouped as one army. Five in the capital; twenty-two at Chenliu; two each at Xianping, Dongming, Taiyuan, Zuocheng, and Nanjing; one each at Xiangyi, Yangwu, and Yun; three at Hua.
88
廣捷舊名左右平遠，建隆二年改。 咸平五年，又選廣德、神威等軍教以標槍旁牌補之。 舊指揮五，景祐中增五，明道中增十，慶曆增三十六，總五十六。 陳留八，咸平六，雍丘四，襄邑、尉氏、許各三，太康、扶溝、南京、亳、河陰、潁、寧陵各二，陳六，滑、曹、鄧、蔡、廣濟、穀熟、永城、襄城、葉各一。
Broad Swift had formerly been Left and Right Level Far; it was renamed in Jianlong 2. In Xianping 5, men from Broad Virtue, Divine Prestige, and other commands were drilled in pike and side-shield work and used to fill vacancies. It had begun with five commands; five were added in Jingyou, ten in Mingdao, and thirty-six in Qingli—for fifty-six in all. Eight at Chenliu; six at Xianping; four at Yongqiu; three each at Xiangyi, Weishi, and Xu; two each at Taikang, Fugou, Nanjing, Bo, Heyin, Ying, and Ningling; six at Chen; one each at Hua, Cao, Deng, Cai, Guangji, Gushu, Yongcheng, Xiangcheng, and Ye.
89
雄威雍熙四年，選神勇兵退入第二等立爲神威，後改今名。 指揮十。 考城、襄邑、陳留各一，南京四，陳二。
Bold Prestige: in Yongxi 4, Divine Courage men who had dropped to second rank were chosen to form Divine Prestige; later it received its present name. Ten commands. One each at Kaocheng, Xiangyi, and Chenliu; four at Nanjing; two at Chen.
90
宣威雍熙四年，選神勇、宣武兵退入次等者立。 上下指揮二。 咸平、襄邑各一。
Proclaim Prestige: in Yongxi 4 it was raised from Divine Courage and Xuanwu men who had slipped to lower rank. Upper and lower ranks: two commands. One each at Xianping and Xiangyi.
91
龍騎建隆間以諸道招致及捕獲群寇立，號有馬步人，見陣即步鬥。 淳化三年，選本軍年多者爲帶甲剩員。 咸平以後，又以本軍及龍猛退兵增之。 舊指揮八，康定中，取配隸充軍者增置爲指揮二十，分三軍。 京師四，尉氏、雍丘、咸平、鄭各二，南京、陳、蔡、河陽、潁、單、四波各一。
Dragon Cavalry: during Jianlong it was raised by summoning men from every circuit and captives taken from bandit bands. Known as "horse-and-foot men," they dismounted and fought on foot as soon as they saw the enemy drawn up. In Chunhua 3, the army's oldest men were chosen as Armored Surplus Members. After Xianping, retirees from the army itself and from Dragon Fierce were also added to swell its numbers. It had formerly stood at eight commands; in Kangding, men sentenced to military service were drafted in until it reached twenty commands, divided among three armies. Four in the capital; two each at Weishi, Yongqiu, Xianping, and Zheng; one each at Nanjing, Chen, Cai, Heyang, Ying, Shan, and Sibo.
92
步鬥雍熙三年，選諸州廂軍之壯勇者立，後廢。 此下二軍，天聖後無。
Foot Combat: in Yongxi 3, brave strong men were chosen from prefectural Comforter Corps and formed into a command; it was later abolished. The two armies below ceased to exist after the Tiansheng era.
93
鞭箭雍熙三年，選兩浙兵爲鞭箭，次等者爲忠節鞭箭。 端拱二年並爲一。 至道元年，發此兵援靈州芻粟，喪車重兵器於浦洛河，詔免死，後廢。
Whip Arrow: in Yongxi 3, Liang-Zhe troops were chosen for Whip Arrow, and second-tier men for Loyal Integrity Whip Arrow. In Duangong 2 the two were merged into one. In Zhidao 1 they were sent to convoy fodder to Lingzhou; wagons and heavy weapons were lost at the Pulu River. An edict spared them execution, but the unit was later abolished.
94
侍衛司侍衛親軍馬步軍都指揮使、副都指揮使、都虞候各一人。 馬軍都指揮使、副都指揮使、都虞候各一人，步軍亦如之。 自馬步軍都虞候已上，其員全闕，即馬、步軍都指揮使等各領其務，與殿前號爲三司。 馬步軍有龍衛神衛左右四廂都指揮使、都虞候。 每指揮有指揮使、副指揮使。 余如殿前司之制。 所領騎兵步兵之額敘列如左：
The Palace Interior Bureau had one Overall Commander, one Deputy Overall Commander, and one Chief Adjutant for the Palace Interior Personal Guard Horse and Foot Armies. The Horse Army had one Overall Commander, one Deputy Overall Commander, and one Chief Adjutant; the Foot Army likewise. When the Chief Adjutant posts and above in the horse-and-foot service stood wholly vacant, the horse and foot Overall Commanders each handled their own affairs, and together with the Palace Front they were called the Three Bureaus. The horse-and-foot armies had four-wing Overall Commanders and Chief Adjutants for Dragon Guard and Divine Guard, left and right. Each command had a Commander and a Deputy Commander. All other arrangements followed the Palace Front Bureau model. The cavalry and infantry quotas under its command are listed below:
95
員僚直顯德中，周平三關，召募強人及選高陽關馳捷兵爲北面兩直。 建隆初，選諸州騎兵及蕃鎮廳頭召募人等爲左三直。 太平興國四年，平太原，選其騎兵爲右三直。 北面兩直，營貝、冀隸高陽關都部署。 大中祥符中，改爲貝州左直、冀州右直，後改四直。 京師二，恩、冀各一。
Officer Direct: in Xiande, when the Zhou pacified the Three Passes, strongmen were recruited and swift troops from Gaoyang Pass were chosen to form the two Northern Direct commands. At the start of Jianlong, prefectural cavalry and recruitment heads from tribal garrison posts were chosen for the three Left Direct commands. In Taiping Xingguo 4, after Taiyuan fell, its cavalry was chosen for the three Right Direct commands. The two Northern Direct commands were encamped at Bei and Ji, under the Gaoyang Pass Overall Deployment. In the Dazhong Xiangfu era they became Bei Prefecture Left Direct and Ji Prefecture Right Direct; later they were reorganized as four direct commands. Two in the capital; one each at En and Ji.
96
龍衛舊號護聖。 周廣順中，改龍捷。 建隆二年，揀去衰老，以諸州所募精勁者補之。 太平興國二年，改分左、右廂。 四年，平太原，選其降兵爲揀中龍衛。 雍熙二年，又揀善槍槊者爲钅屈直。 淳化三年，選剩員堪披甲者爲帶甲剩員。 五年，又揀善左射者爲左射。 指揮四十四。 京師三十八，雍丘、尉氏、河陽各一，澶三。
Dragon Guard had formerly been Protecting Sageliness. Under the Later Zhou in Guangshun it was renamed Dragon Swift. In Jianlong 2 the aged were culled and replaced with vigorous recruits drawn from the prefectures. In Taiping Xingguo 2 it was divided into left and right wings. In year 4, after Taiyuan fell, surrendered troops were chosen for Selected Dragon Guard. In Yongxi 2, men skilled with spear and halberd were chosen for Bent Bow Direct. In Chunhua 3, surplus members still fit to bear armor were chosen as Armored Surplus Members. In year 5, men skilled at left-handed shooting were chosen for Left Shooter. Forty-four commands. Thirty-eight in the capital; one each at Yongqiu, Weishi, and Heyang; three at Chan.
97
忠猛咸平一年置。 指揮一。 定州。
Loyal Fierce: established in Xianping 1. One command. Stationed at Ding Prefecture.
98
散員咸平五年置。 指揮一。 定州。
Loose Members: established in Xianping 5. One command. Stationed at Ding Prefecture.
99
驍捷周顯德中，平三關，揀諸州士卒壯勇者爲河北驍捷。 宋初，隸高陽關都部署。 建隆二年，廢左右驍武，以其兵來隸。 乾德中，又選備征及嵐州歸附之兵爲河南驍捷，其後止以驍捷爲名。 太平興國四年，平太原，揀閱降兵爲揀中驍捷。 淳化四年，又置新立驍捷。 至道三年，分驍捷爲左、右廂。 咸平五年，以其年多者爲帶甲剩員。 指揮二十六。 尉氏新立、陳揀中各一，恩十四，冀十。
Fierce Swift: in Later Zhou Xiande, after the Three Passes were pacified, brave strong soldiers from the prefectures were chosen for Hebei Fierce Swift. In the early Song it fell under the Gaoyang Pass Overall Deployment. In Jianlong 2 the Left and Right Martial Awesome commands were abolished and their troops transferred here. In Qiande, campaign-reserve troops and surrendered men from Lan Prefecture were also chosen for Henan Fierce Swift; afterward only the name Fierce Swift was retained. In Taiping Xingguo 4, after Taiyuan fell, surrendered troops were reviewed and formed into Selected Fierce Swift. In Chunhua 4 Newly Established Fierce Swift was added as well. In Zhidao 3 Fierce Swift was split into left and right wings. In Xianping 5 the oldest men were formed into Armored Surplus Members. Twenty-six commands. One each at Weishi (Newly Established) and Chen (Selected); fourteen at En; ten at Ji.
100
雲騎舊號左右備征，建隆二年改。 開寶以後，募子弟爲雲騎，以其次爲武騎，又選騎兵之次等爲武騎，又選本軍年多者爲帶甲剩員。 指揮十五。 京師十一，陳留、西京各一，鞏二。
Cloud Cavalry had formerly been Left and Right Campaign Reserve; it was renamed in Jianlong 2. After Kaibao, soldiers' sons were recruited as Cloud Cavalry and the next rank as Martial Cavalry; second-tier cavalry were also chosen for Martial Cavalry, and the army's oldest men for Armored Surplus Members. Fifteen commands. Eleven commands in the capital; one each at Chenliu and the Western Capital; two at Gong.
101
歸明神武太平興國四年，親征幽州，以其降兵立此軍。 初指揮一，後增爲四。 雍丘。
Surrendered Ming Divine Martial: in Taiping Xingguo 4, when the emperor personally campaigned against Youzhou, this army was raised from surrendered troops. It began with one command; later the total rose to four. Stationed at Yongqiu.
102
克勝本潞州騎兵，端拱初升。 指揮二。 潞。
Overcome Victory had originally been Luzhou cavalry; it was promoted at the start of Duangong. Two commands. Stationed at Lu Prefecture.
103
驍銳舊名散員指揮，咸平四年改。 指揮四。 莫三，冀一。
Fierce Sharp had formerly been the Loose Members command; it was renamed in Xianping 4. Four commands. Three at Mo; one at Ji.
104
驍武本河北諸州忠烈、威邊、騎射等兵。 淳化四年，揀閱其材，與雲騎、武騎等立，得自置馬，分左、右廂。 指揮二十。 北京七，真定三，定六，相、懷、洺、邢各一。
Fierce Martial was originally drawn from Loyal Martyrs, Awesome Border, Mounted Archers, and other Hebei prefectural forces. In Chunhua 4 their fitness was reviewed; together with Cloud Cavalry, Martial Cavalry, and others they were organized, allowed to supply their own horses, and split into left and right wings. Twenty commands. Seven at the Northern Capital; three at Zhending; six at Ding; one each at Xiang, Huai, Ming, and Xing.
105
武清晉州騎兵。 端拱二年，以其久在北鄙，有屯戍之勞，選勇悍者就升。 指揮一。 晉。
Martial Clear: Jin Prefecture cavalry. In Duangong 2, because they had long served on the northern frontier and borne garrison duty, the bravest and fiercest were selected for promotion. One command. Stationed at Jin Prefecture.
106
有馬勁勇咸平四年，選江東諸州兵立。 慶曆中，分置第六、第七。 總指揮七。 太原二，代、嵐各一，磁三。
Strong Steed with Horses: in Xianping 4, troops were chosen from Jiangdong prefectures and formed into a command. During Qingli the sixth and seventh commands were added separately. Seven commands in all. Two at Taiyuan; one each at Dai and Lan; three at Ci.
107
雲翼舊指揮三十三，景祐以後，增置二十三，分左、右廂，總五十六。 真定、雄、瀛、深、趙、永寧各三，定、冀各六，保五，滄、北平、永靜、順安、保定各二，莫、邢、霸各一，廣信、安肅各四。
Cloud Wing had formerly numbered thirty-three commands; after Jingyou twenty-three more were added and the force was divided into left and right wings—for fifty-six in all. Three each at Zhending, Xiong, Ying, Shen, Zhao, and Yongning; six each at Ding and Ji; five at Bao; two each at Cang, Beiping, Yongjing, Shun'an, and Baoding; one each at Mo, Xing, and Ba; four each at Guangxin and Ansu.
108
廳子本石州城立。 景德元年，改徙營相州。 慶曆初，升禁軍。 指揮六。 定一，相五。
Hall Sons was originally raised at Shizhou city. In Jingde 1 it was transferred and encamped at Xiang Prefecture. At the beginning of Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Corps. Six commands. One at Ding; five at Xiang.
109
萬捷開寶中，募趙、相、滄、冀州民立。 大中祥符中，以驍武、雲騎退兵隸之。 指揮七。 相、冀、遼各二，滄一。
Ten Thousand Swift: during Kaibao, commoners from Zhao, Xiang, Cang, and Ji prefectures were recruited and formed into a command. During Dazhong Xiangfu, men retired from Fierce Martial and Cloud Cavalry were transferred to it. Seven commands. Two each at Xiang, Ji, and Liao; one at Cang.
110
雲捷太平興國四年，選諸軍中應募子弟及教駿、借事、備征等有武幹者立。 大中祥符五年，以寧朔退兵隸之。 指揮十二。 尉氏、咸平、西京、北京、澶各二，汝、懷各一。
Cloud Swift: in Taiping Xingguo 4, recruited soldiers' sons and men of martial talent among horse trainers, temporary capital assignees, and campaign reserves were chosen from various armies and formed into a command. In Dazhong Xiangfu 5, men retired from Secure the North were transferred to it. Twelve commands. Two each at Weishi, Xianping, the Western Capital, the Northern Capital, and Chan; one each at Ru and Huai.
111
橫塞咸平三年，選諸軍威邊、騎射及在京借事立。 指揮七。 雍丘、咸平、考城、襄邑、寧陵各一，衛二。
Transverse Barrier: in Xianping 3, Awesome Border and Mounted Archers from various armies and temporary assignees in the capital were chosen and formed into a command. Seven commands. One each at Yongqiu, Xianping, Kaocheng, Xiangyi, and Ningling; two at Wei.
112
員僚剩員直禁軍員僚以罪責降者充。 此下至騎捷凡六軍，天聖後無。
Officer Surplus Direct: Palace Corps officer surplus posts were filled by officers demoted for disciplinary offenses. From here through Cavalry Swift there were six armies in all; none remained after Tiansheng.
113
清塞周立，指揮二。 其一北蕃歸附之衆，營壽州； 其一破淮南紫金山砦所得騎軍，營延州。 宋初，選本軍子弟補其缺。 太平興國三年，又得泉州、兩浙兵以益之。
Clear Barrier: established under the Later Zhou, with two commands. One was drawn from northern tribes who had submitted and was encamped at Shou Prefecture; the other was cavalry taken when the Zijin Mountain stockade in Huainan was captured and was encamped at Yan Prefecture. In the early Song, soldiers' sons from the army were chosen to fill vacancies. In Taiping Xingguo 3, Quanzhou and Liangzhe troops were also added to augment it.
114
飛捷本威虜軍、保州、易州靜塞兵、定州廳子軍立。 淳化元年，詔赴闕揀閱，以靜塞爲三等，廳子爲一等，改今名。 指揮四。
Flying Swift was originally raised from the Awesome Barbarians army, Baozhou troops, Yizhou Secure the Frontier troops, and the Dingzhou Hall Sons army. In Chunhua 1, an edict ordered them to the capital for review; Secure the Frontier was ranked third grade and Hall Sons first grade, and they received the present name. Four commands.
115
驍駿本壽州鹹聖軍，咸平三年改。 指揮一。
Fierce Steed had originally been the Shou Prefecture Salt Sageliness army; it was renamed in Xianping 3. One command.
116
揀中夏州廳子本夏州家戶。 淳化五年，河西行營都部署李繼隆遣部送京師立，指揮一。
Selected Hall Sons of Xia Prefecture was originally drawn from Xia Prefecture household troops. In Chunhua 5, Li Jilong, overall deployment of the Hexi field headquarters, sent a detachment escorted to the capital and formed it into one command.
117
騎捷本雍州強人指揮，咸平三年改。 分營瀛、莫。 指揮四。
Cavalry Swift had originally been the Yong Prefecture strongmen command; it was renamed in Xianping 3. It was camped separately at Ying and Mo. Four commands.
118
武騎指揮一十一。 京師、雍丘各一，尉氏三，陳留、考城、咸平、鄭各一，西京二。 此下至有馬雄略凡十二軍。 《三朝志》無。
Martial Cavalry: eleven commands. One each in the capital and at Yongqiu; three at Weishi; one each at Chenliu, Kaocheng, Xianping, and Zheng; two at the Western Capital. From here through Mounted Bold Strategy there were twelve armies in all. Not recorded in the Records of the Three Reigns.
119
驍騎指揮一，太原。
Fierce Cavalry: one command, stationed at Taiyuan.
120
無敵河北沿邊廂兵，慶曆二年升禁軍。 總指揮六。 定、北平各二，安肅、廣信各一。
Invincible: Hebei frontier Comforter Corps; promoted to the Palace Corps in Qingli 2. Six commands in all. Two each at Ding and Beiping; one each at Ansu and Guangxin.
121
忠銳廣信廂兵有馬者，慶曆二年升禁軍。 指揮一。
Loyal Sharp: mounted men from the Guangxin Comforter Corps; promoted to the Palace Corps in Qingli 2. One command.
122
威邊諸州廂兵，惟保州教戰射，隸巡檢司。 慶曆初，升禁軍。 指揮二。 定、保各一。
Awesome Border: Comforter Corps from various prefectures; only at Baozhou were they drilled in combat archery, under the patrol office. At the beginning of Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Corps. Two commands. One each at Ding and Bao.
123
飛騎麟州廂兵，慶曆初，升禁軍。 指揮二。
Flying Cavalry: Lin Prefecture Comforter Corps; at the beginning of Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Corps. Two commands.
124
威遠府州廂兵，本胡騎之精銳，慶曆初，升禁軍。 指揮二。
Awesome Distance: Fu Prefecture Comforter Corps, originally elite Hu cavalry; at the beginning of Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Corps. Two commands.
125
克戎并州廂軍有馬者，康定中，升禁軍。 指揮一。
Overcome Foe: mounted men from the Bing Prefecture Comforter Corps; during Kangding it was promoted to the Palace Corps. One command.
126
有馬安塞慶州廂軍，慶曆中，升禁軍。 指揮一。
Mounted Secure the Frontier: Qing Prefecture Comforter Corps; during Qingli it was promoted to the Palace Corps. One command.
127
蕃落陝西沿邊廂兵有馬者，天禧後，升禁軍，極邊城砦悉置。 至慶曆中，總指揮八十三。 環五，延、慶各四，秦並外砦十七，原、渭並外砦各十二，德順並外砦十二，鳳翔、涇並外砦、儀、保安各二，隴外一。
Tribal Frontier: mounted men from Shaanxi frontier Comforter Corps; after Tianxi they were promoted to the Palace Corps and established at every outermost frontier citadel and stockade. By the Qingli era there were eighty-three commands in all. Five at Huan; four each at Yan and Qing; seventeen at Qin including outer stockades; twelve each at Yuan and Wei including outer stockades; twelve at Deshun including outer stockades; two each at Fengxiang, Jing including outer stockades, Yi, and Bao'an; one outside Long.
128
并州騎射諸道廂軍惟并州路有馬備征役，慶曆五年升禁軍。 指揮一。
Bing Prefecture Mounted Archers: among circuit Comforter Corps, only the Bingzhou route had mounted men ready for campaign service; it was promoted to the Palace Corps in Qingli 5. One command.
129
有馬雄略至和二年置，指揮三。 廣、桂、邕各一。
Mounted Bold Strategy: established in Zhihe 2, with three commands. One each at Guang, Gui, and Yong.
130
神衛晉曰奉國軍，周改虎捷。 建隆二年，揀閱諸州所募禁軍增補。 乾德三年，西川行營都部署王全斌偽署感化、耀武等軍平寇者功，請備禁旅，詔並爲虎捷。 太平興國二年改。 舊水虎翼即軍中習水戰者，是歲改爲神衛水軍，又於剩員中選可備征役者立爲揀中神衛。 大中祥符後，剩員又有帶甲、看倉草場、看船之名，凡四等，皆選本軍年多者補。 宋初，指揮四十六，仁宗後，止存指揮三十一。 京師。
Divine Guard: under the Jin it was called the Reverent State army; under the Zhou it was renamed Tiger Swift. In Jianlong 2, recruited Palace Corps from the prefectures were reviewed and used to fill vacancies. In Qiande 3, Wang Quanbin, overall deployment of the Sichuan field headquarters, citing the merits of those who had pacified bandits under the puppet titles Persuade Transformation and Glorious Martial and other armies, asked that they join the palace guard; an edict made them all Tiger Swift. It was renamed in Taiping Xingguo 2. The old Water Tiger Wing were troops in the army trained for river combat; that year they became Divine Guard Navy, and men still fit for campaign service were also chosen from surplus members to form Selected Divine Guard. After Dazhong Xiangfu, surplus members also bore the designations Armored, Warehouse and Pasture Watch, and Boat Watch—four grades in all—all filled by choosing the oldest men in the army. In the early Song there were forty-six commands; after Renzong only thirty-one remained. Stationed in the capital.
131
步武本鄉軍選充神勇、宣武，雍熙三年，揀其次等者立。 慶曆中，增指揮六。 陳。
Foot Martial was originally local militia chosen to fill Divine Courage and Xuanwu; in Yongxi 3, men of second rank were selected and formed into a command. During Qingli six commands were added. Stationed at Chen Prefecture.
132
虎翼宋初，號雄武弩手。 太平興國二年，選壯勇者爲上鐵林，其次爲下鐵林。 雍熙四年，改爲左、右廂，各三軍。 咸平五年，以威虎軍來隸。 景德三年，選效順兵補其缺。 大中祥符五年，擇本軍善水戰者爲上虎翼，六，年又選江、淮習水卒于金明池按試戰棹，立爲虎翼軍。 江、浙、淮南諸州，亦准此選置。 七年，改爲虎翼水軍。 舊指揮七十五，慶曆中，增置二十一，總九十六。 京師九十並水軍一，襄邑、東明、單各一，長葛一。
Tiger Wing: in the early Song it was called Bold Martial crossbowmen. In Taiping Xingguo 2, strong brave men were chosen as Upper Iron Forest and the next rank as Lower Iron Forest. In Yongxi 4 it was reorganized into left and right wings, three armies each. In Xianping 5 the Mighty Tiger army was transferred under it. In Jingde 3 Loyal Submission troops were chosen to fill vacancies. In Dazhong Xiangfu 5 the army's best water fighters were picked for Upper Tiger Wing; in the same year Yangtze-Huai men drilled in watercraft were tested at Jinming Pool and formed as Tiger Wing. Jiangsu, Zhejiang, and Huainan prefectures likewise set up units by the same procedure. In year 7 it was renamed Tiger Wing Navy. It had formerly numbered seventy-five commands; in Qingli twenty-one more were added, for ninety-six in all. Ninety in the capital and one naval command; one each at Xiangyi, Dongming, and Shan; one at Changge.
133
奉節乾德三年平蜀，得其兵立爲奉議，後改今名。 景德三年，又選立上奉節。 指揮五，京師。
Reverent Obedience: in Qiande 3, after Shu was pacified, its troops were formed as Reverent Discussion and later given their present name. In Jingde 3 Upper Reverent Obedience was added as well. Five commands; stationed in the capital.
134
武衛太平興國中，募河北諸州兵立。 舊指揮十六，慶曆中，河北增置爲指揮六十七。 南京、真定、淄各四，北京、澶、相、邢、懷、趙、棣、洺、德、祁、通利、乾寧、廣濟各一，青五，鄆、徐、兗、曹、濮、沂、濟、單、萊、濰、登、淮陽、瀛、博各二，齊、密、滄各三。
Martial Guard: during Taiping Xingguo, men were recruited from Hebei prefectures to form the command. It had formerly stood at sixteen commands; in Qingli Hebei additions brought the total to sixty-seven. Four commands each at Nanjing, Zhending, and Zi; one each at the Northern Capital, Chan, Xiang, Xing, Huai, Zhao, Di, Ming, De, Qi, Tongli, Qianning, and Guangji; five at Qing; two each at Yun, Xu, Yan, Cao, Pu, Yi, Ji, Shan, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, Ying, and Bo; three each at Qi, Mi, and Cang.
135
雄武並雄武弩手、床子弩雄武、揀中雄武、飛山雄武、揀中歸明雄武，總指揮三十四。 京師十三，太原、尉氏、南京、鄭、汝、寧陵各二，咸平、東明、雍丘、襄邑、許、曹、廣濟、穀熟、長葛各一。
Bold Martial together with Bold Martial Crossbowmen, Bed-Frame Crossbow Bold Martial, Selected Bold Martial, Flying Mountain Bold Martial, and Selected Return-to-Transformation Bold Martial: thirty-four commands in all. Thirteen in the capital; two each at Taiyuan, Weishi, Nanjing, Zheng, Ru, and Ningling; one each at Xianping, Dongming, Yongqiu, Xiangyi, Xu, Cao, Guangji, Gushu, and Changge.
136
川效忠太平興四三年，選諸州廂兵歸京師者立。 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵部送京師者產爲川效忠。 景德元年，以德清廂軍及威遠兵增之。 舊指揮二十八，後減爲七。 南京六，寧陵一。
Sichuan Render Loyalty: in Taiping Xingguo 3, Comforter Corps troops sent back to the capital from the prefectures were formed into a command. In Chunhua 4, Wei Oar and Secure Ning troops from the Sichuan gorges escorted to the capital were also formed as Sichuan Render Loyalty. In Jingde 1 it was augmented with Deqing Comforter Corps and Mighty Far troops. It had formerly numbered twenty-eight commands; later it was reduced to seven. Six at Nanjing; one at Ningling.
137
效順宋初，征潞州，以降卒立。 指揮一。 襄邑。
Loyal Submission: in the early Song, during the campaign against Luzhou, it was formed from surrendered soldiers. One command. Stationed at Xiangyi.
138
雄勝開寶中，以剩員立。 太平興國中，選入上鐵林，餘如故。 又有雄勝剩員。 指揮三。 峽、冀、濟各一。
Bold Victory: during Kaibao it was formed from surplus members. During Taiping Xingguo, men were chosen for Upper Iron Forest; the rest remained as before. There were also Bold Victory surplus members. Three commands. One command each at Xia, Ji, and Jizhou.
139
揀中雄勇開寶中立，以常寧雄勇、效順等軍剩員中選其強者立爲揀中。 大中祥符二年，又選歸遠軍爲新立。 舊指揮四，後損爲一。 襄邑。
Selected Bold Courage: established in Kaibao; the strongest surplus members from Secure Tranquility Bold Courage, Loyal Submission, and other armies were chosen to form Selected Bold Courage. In Dazhong Xiangfu 2 Return Far troops were also chosen for Newly Established Bold Courage. It had formerly stood at four commands; later it was reduced to one. Stationed at Xiangyi.
140
懷勇開寶四年，揀蜀兵之在京師者立，指揮三。 雍丘二，陳一。
Grateful Courage: in Kaibao 4, Shu soldiers then in the capital were chosen and formed; three commands. Two at Yongqiu; one at Chen.
141
威寧淳化中，部送西川賊帥五小波脅從之兵歸京師立。 咸平元年，又以散員直增補。 指揮一。 許。
Secure Tranquility: during Chunhua, troops forced to follow the western Sichuan rebel Wang Xiaobo were escorted back to the capital and formed into a command. In Xianping 1 it was also filled out with Loose Member Direct troops. One command. Stationed at Xu.
142
飛虎本虎翼、廣武兵屯西川無家屬者，太平興國中，歸京師。 指揮三。 陳留二，咸平一。
Flying Tiger: originally Tiger Wing and Broad Martial troops posted in western Sichuan without families; during Taiping Xingguo they returned to the capital. Three commands. Two at Chenliu; one at Xianping.
143
懷順本淮南兵，舊號懷德。 建隆二年改。 指揮一。 霸。
Grateful Submission: originally Huainan troops; it had formerly been called Grateful Virtue. It was renamed in Jianlong 2. One command. Stationed at Ba.
144
歸聖開寶七年，以李從善所領兵及水軍立。 八年，平江南，又以其降兵增補，指揮一。 雍丘。
Return to Sageliness: in Kaibao 7 it was formed from the troops under Li Congshan and the naval force. In year 8, after Jiangnan was pacified, surrendered troops were added to fill it; one command. Stationed at Yongqiu.
145
順聖太平興國中，部送兩浙兵歸京師立。 指揮一。 鞏。
Obedient Sageliness: during Taiping Xingguo, Liang-Zhe troops escorted back to the capital were formed into a command. One command. Stationed at Gong.
146
懷恩乾德三年，平蜀，得其軍立。 指揮三。 荊南二，鄂一。
Grateful Favor: in Qiande 3, after Shu was pacified, its army was taken and formed into a command. Three commands. Two at Jingnan; one at E.
147
揀中懷愛本蜀兵，與懷恩同立，又拔精銳者爲揀中。 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵次等者立爲牽船，以給河漕之役。 舊指揮三，後損爲一。 寧陵。
Selected Grateful Love: originally Shu troops; it was formed together with Grateful Favor, and the best men were also picked out as Selected Grateful Love. In Chunhua 4, second-tier Wei Oar and Secure Ning troops from the Sichuan gorges were also formed as Boat-Hauling to supply labor for river grain transport. It had formerly stood at three commands; later it was reduced to one. Stationed at Ningling.
148
勇捷太平興國四年，征太原立，分左、右廂，以諸州庫兵補左廂，廣濟、開山兵補右廂。 指揮二十六。 襄邑、北京、澶、陳、壽、汝、曹、宿各二，咸平、西京、南京、亳、甯、洪、河陰、鞏、長葛、韋城各一。
Bold Swift: in Taiping Xingguo 4, raised during the Taiyuan campaign, it was split into left and right wings; prefectural depot troops filled the left wing and Guangji and Kaishan troops the right. Twenty-six commands. Two commands each at Xiangyi, the Northern Capital, Chan, Chen, Shou, Ru, Cao, and Su; one each at Xianping, the Western Capital, Nanjing, Bo, Ning, Hong, Heyin, Gong, Changge, and Weicheng.
149
威武太平興國四年，征太原立，分左、右廂，以江南歸化兵補左廂，兩浙順化兵補右廂。 大中祥符五年，又立下威武。 共指揮十三。 西京、河陽、鄭、鄆、澶、滑、濮、通利、鞏、河陰、永城各一，曹二。
Martial Prestige: in Taiping Xingguo 4, raised during the Taiyuan campaign, it was split into left and right wings; Jiangnan Return-to-Transformation troops filled the left wing and Liang-Zhe Gentle Transformation troops the right. In Dazhong Xiangfu 5 Lower Martial Prestige was added as well. Thirteen commands in all. One command each at the Western Capital, Heyang, Zheng, Yun, Chan, Hua, Pu, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, and Yongcheng; two at Cao.
150
靜戎弩手選江南歸化兵及諸州廂兵壯實者立。 指揮四。 河陽、澶、衛、通利各一。
Secure the Frontier Crossbowmen: formed by choosing sturdy Jiangnan Return-to-Transformation troops and prefectural Comforter Corps. Four commands. One command each at Heyang, Chan, Wei, and Tongli.
151
平塞弩手本兩浙順化軍，揀其強壯立爲弩手，又以江、浙逋負官物隸窯務徒役者爲揀中平塞。 指揮四。 咸平、亳、河陽、白波各一。
Secure the Pass Crossbowmen: originally the Liang-Zhe Gentle Transformation army; the strongest were chosen as crossbowmen, and men from Jiang-Zhe who owed government goods and served as kiln laborers were formed as Selected Secure the Pass. Four commands. One command each at Xianping, Bo, Heyang, and Baibo.
152
新立弩手本勁勇兵，太平興國中，選其善弩者立。 指揮一。 廣濟。
Newly Established Crossbowmen: originally Vigorous Courage troops; during Taiping Xingguo, men skilled with the crossbow were chosen and formed into a command. One command. Stationed at Guangji.
153
忠勇咸平五年，以易州兵能禽賊者立。 指揮一。 成都。
Loyal Courage: in Xianping 5 it was formed from Yizhou troops who had proved able to capture bandits. One command. Stationed at Chengdu.
154
甯遠大中祥符六年，選西川克寧、威棹兵立。 舊指揮五，皇祐及至和中，增置爲八。 戎三，遂、梓、嘉、雅、江安各一。
Secure Distance: in Dazhong Xiangfu 6, Secure Ning and Wei Oar troops from western Sichuan were chosen and formed into a command. It had formerly stood at five commands; from Huangyou through Zhihe the total rose to eight. Three at Rong; one each at Suí, Zī, Jia, Ya, and Jiang'an.
155
忠節太平興國三年，選諸州廂軍之強壯者立。 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧兵立爲川忠節。 舊指揮二十四，後增教閱忠節總爲六十。 雍丘、襄邑、寧陵各三，陳留、咸平、東明、亳、河陰、永城各二，南京五，太康、陽武、許、江寧、揚、廬、宿、壽、楚、真、泗、泰、滁、岳、澧、池、歙、信、太平、饒、宣、洪、虔、吉、臨江、興國、廣濟、南康、廣德、長葛各一，合流四。
Loyal Integrity: in Taiping Xingguo 3, the strongest men from prefectural Comforter Corps were chosen and formed into a command. In Chunhua 4, Wei Oar and Secure Ning troops from the Sichuan gorges were also formed as Sichuan Loyal Integrity. It had formerly numbered twenty-four commands; later Drill-Review Loyal Integrity was added, for sixty in all. Three each at Yongqiu, Xiangyi, and Ningling; two each at Chenliu, Xianping, Dongming, Bo, Heyin, and Yongcheng; five at Nanjing; one each at Taikang, Yangwu, Xu, Jiangning, Yang, Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Tai, Chuzhou, Yue, Li, Chi, She, Xin, Taiping, Rao, Xuan, Hong, Qian, Ji, Linjiang, Xingguo, Guangji, Nankang, Guangde, and Changge; four at Heliu.
156
神威咸平三年，選京師諸司庫務兵立。 上下指揮十三。 陳留三，許、鞏各二，雍丘、考城、咸平、河陽、廣濟、白波各一。
Divine Prestige: in Xianping 3, depot troops from various capital bureaus were chosen and formed into a command. Upper and lower ranks: thirteen commands in all. Three at Chenliu; two each at Xu and Gong; one each at Yongqiu, Kaocheng, Xianping, Heyang, Guangji, and Baibo.
157
歸遠雍熙三年，王師北征，拔飛狐、靈丘，得其降卒立，咸平二年，選諸州雜犯兵增之。 舊指揮三，天聖中，增置爲十六。 陳、許、亳、壽、宿、鄧、襄、鼎各一，荊南、澧、潭、洪各二。
Return Far: in Yongxi 3, during the northern campaign, Feihu and Lingqiu were taken and surrendered soldiers formed into a command; in Xianping 2 miscellaneous offenders from the prefectures were chosen to augment it. It had formerly stood at three commands; in Tiansheng the total rose to sixteen. One command each at Chen, Xu, Bo, Shou, Su, Deng, Xiang, and Ding; two each at Jingnan, Li, Tan, and Hong.
158
雄略咸平六年，選諸州廂兵及香藥遞鋪兵立。 舊指揮十五，皇祐五年，增置爲二十五。 荊南五，潭四，鼎、澧各二，廣、辰、桂各二，許、全、邵、容各一。
Bold Strategy: in Xianping 6, prefectural Comforter Corps and aromatics courier-post troops were chosen and formed into a command. It had formerly stood at fifteen commands; in Huangyou 5 the total rose to twenty-five. Five at Jingnan; four at Tan; two each at Ding and Li; two each at Guang, Chen, and Gui; one each at Xu, Quan, Shao, and Rong.
159
威猛咸平三年，選諸州廂兵及召募者立。 上下指揮十。 襄邑四，咸平、許、長葛各二。
Fierce Martial: in Xianping 3, prefectural Comforter Corps and recruits were chosen and formed into a command. Upper and lower ranks: ten commands in all. Four at Xiangyi; two each at Xianping, Xu, and Changge.
160
神銳咸平六年，料簡河東兵立。 大中祥符五年，以本軍及神虎兵年多者爲帶甲剩員。 指揮二十六。 太原六，潞、晉各三，澤、汾、隰、平定各二，代、絳、忻、遼、邢、威勝各一。
Divine Sharp: in Xianping 6 it was formed by reviewing Hedong troops. In Dazhong Xiangfu 5 the oldest men in this army and in Divine Tiger were formed into Armored Surplus Members. Twenty-six commands. Six at Taiyuan; three each at Lu and Jin; two each at Ze, Fen, Xi, and Pingding; one each at Dai, Jiang, Xin, Liao, Xing, and Weisheng.
161
神虎咸平五年，選陝西州兵馬立。 六年，又料簡河東州兵立，以西路河東兵之。 指揮二十六。 永興六，鳳翔、河中、忻、晉、威勝各二，太原、秦、延、鄜、華各一，潞州三。
Divine Tiger: in Xianping 5 it was formed by selecting Shaanxi prefectural horse and foot. In year 6, Hedong prefectural troops were reviewed again to form the command, filled from western-route Hedong forces. Twenty-six commands. Six at Yongxing; two each at Fengxiang, Hezhong, Xin, Jin, and Weisheng; one each at Taiyuan, Qin, Yan, Fu, and Hua; three at Lu.
162
保捷咸平四年，詔陝西沿邊選鄉丁保毅升充。 舊指揮四十五，慶曆中，揀鄉弓手增置，總一百三十五。 永興十二，同九，秦八，河中、汾、涇各七，渭、寧、耀各六，鳳翔、延、儀、華、隴、解、乾各五，陝、原、鄜各四，成三，慶、鳳、坊、晉、鎮戎各二，環、丹、商、虢、階、慶成、德順各一。
Secure Swift: in Xianping 4, an edict promoted local Secure Resolution militia selected along the Shaanxi frontier. It had formerly stood at forty-five commands; during Qingli local bowmen were added, bringing the total to one hundred thirty-five. Twelve at Yongxing; nine at Tong; eight at Qin; seven each at Hezhong, Fen, and Jing; six each at Wei, Ning, and Yao; five each at Fengxiang, Yan, Yi, Hua, Long, Jie, and Qian; four each at Shaan, Yuan, and Fu; three at Cheng; two each at Qing, Feng, Fang, Jin, and Zhenrong; one each at Huan, Dan, Shang, Guo, Jie, Qingcheng, and Deshun.
163
振武舊指揮四十，慶曆後，河北增置爲指揮四十二，陝西增置爲指揮三十九，總八十一。 北京、澶、相、懷、衛、霸、莫、祁、棣、趙、濱、洺、保安、永寧、通利、安肅、儀各一，真定、定、瀛、保、恩、邢、深、博、永靜、乾、寧陵、涇各二，延六，邠、隴各七，鄜、寧各五，磁四，滄、原各三。
Quake Martial: formerly forty commands; after Qingli Hebei added forty-two and Shaanxi thirty-nine, for eighty-one in all. One each at Northern Capital, Chan, Xiang, Huai, Wei, Ba, Mo, Qi, Di, Zhao, Bin, Ming, Bao'an, Yongning, Tongli, Ansu, and Yi; two each at Zhending, Ding, Ying, Bao, En, Xing, Shen, Bo, Yongjing, Qian, Ningling, and Jing; six at Yan; seven each at Bin and Long; five each at Fu and Ning; four at Ci; three each at Cang and Yuan.
164
橋道太平興國三年，選諸州廂兵次等者立。 淳化四年，又選川峽威棹、克寧爲川橋道。 總指揮十八。 襄邑、咸平、陽武各二，陳留、東明、尉氏、太康、西京、河陽、濮、鄆、鞏、河陰、白波、寧陵各一。
Bridge Road: in Taiping Xingguo 3, second-tier Comforter Corps from the prefectures were chosen and formed into a command. In Chunhua 4, Wei Oar and Secure Ning troops from the Sichuan gorges were also chosen for Sichuan Bridge Road. Eighteen commands in all. Two each at Xiangyi, Xianping, and Yangwu; one each at Chenliu, Dongming, Weishi, Taikang, Western Capital, Heyang, Pu, Yun, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, and Ningling.
165
清塞太平興國初立。 左、右廂，舊指揮二十三，嘉祐中並爲十三。 曹二，鄭、鄆、滑、通利、鞏、河陰、白波、汜水、長葛各一。
Clear Barrier: established at the opening of Taiping Xingguo. Left and right wings: formerly twenty-three commands; in Jiayou they were consolidated to thirteen. Two at Cao; one each at Zheng, Yun, Hua, Tongli, Gong, Heyin, Baibo, Sishui, and Changge.
166
招收端拱中，獲通州大沙洲賊衆立，缺則以江、浙招致海賊補之。 又收端拱中逃軍來復者，原其罪爲德壽軍，後改今名，隸保州巡檢司，慶曆初，升禁軍，爲指揮十七。 保四，霸、信安各三，定、軍城砦各二，廣信、安肅、順安各一。
Recruit Accept: in the Duangong era it was formed from bandits captured at Dashazhou in Tong Prefecture; vacancies were filled by recruiting sea bandits from Jiang and Zhe. Duangong-era deserters who came back were also enrolled, pardoned, and formed as the Virtue Longevity Army—later renamed Recruit Accept—under the Bao Prefecture patrol office; at the start of Qingli it was promoted to Palace Corps, with seventeen commands. Four at Bao; three each at Ba and Xin'an; two each at Ding and Juncheng Stockade; one each at Guangxin, Ansu, and Shun'an.
167
壯勇本招獲群盜配近京徒役者揀拔立，咸平三年，選諸雜犯兵增之。 至道三年，江、浙發運使楊允恭禽海賊送闕下增補，旋廢。 舊指揮三，慶曆中，增置爲七。 耀、解、滑各二，許一。
Stalwart Courage: originally formed from captured bandits assigned to corvée near the capital; in Xianping 3 miscellaneous offenders from the armies were added. In Zhidao 3, Jiang-Zhe transport commissioner Yang Yonggong captured sea bandits and sent them to court to fill vacancies; the practice was soon abolished. It had formerly stood at three commands; during Qingli the total rose to seven. Two each at Yao, Jie, and Hua; one at Xu.
168
宣效咸平三年，選六軍、窯務、軍營務、天駟監效役、店宅務、州兵立。 景德元年，又揀本軍材勇者爲揀中宣效。 舊指揮五，後損爲二。 京師。
Proclaim Effect: in Xianping 3, men were taken from the Six Armies, Kiln Office, Military Camp Office, Fine Steeds corvée, Real Estate Office, and prefectural troops. In Jingde 1 the bravest men in this army were chosen again as Selected Proclaim Effect. It had formerly stood at five commands; later it was cut to two. Capital.
169
來化雍熙中，以飛狐、靈丘歸附之衆立，又以朔州內附牽擺兵立，後廢。 舊指揮三，後損爲二。 寧陵。
Come Transform: in the Yongxi era it was formed from submitters at Feihu and Lingqiu and from Shuozhou's internally submitted relocated troops; later abolished. It had formerly stood at three commands; later it was cut to two. Ningling.
170
歸恩雍熙中，平塞陷邊之民黥面放還立，分有家屬者隸左廂，無者隸右廂。 指揮二。 亳。
Return Grace: in the Yongxi era it was formed from frontier people tattooed and released during frontier fort pacification; men with families joined the left wing, those without the right. Two commands. Bo.
171
順化太平興國三年，以兩浙兵之次等者立。 指揮二。 河陽、鄆各一。
Harmonize Transform: in Taiping Xingguo 3 it was formed from second-tier Two Zhe troops. Two commands. One each at Heyang and Yun.
172
左右清衛大中祥符八年立，以奉諸宮觀灑掃之役。 指揮二。 此下至強壯軍員凡八軍，天聖後無。
Left and Right Clear Guard: established in Dazhong Xiangfu 8 for sweeping and sprinkling duty at palace shrines. Two commands. From here through Strong Stalwart Corps Members there were eight armies in all; after Tiansheng none remained.
173
川員僚直本西蜀賊全師雄所署將領，乾德中立。
Sichuan Officer Direct: originally officers commissioned by the Western Shu rebel Quan Shixiong; established under Qiande.
174
造船務乾德初，平荊湖，選其軍善治舟楫者立。
Shipbuilding Office: at the start of Qiande, after pacifying Jinghu, men skilled at building boats were chosen from that army and formed into a command.
175
歸明羽林太平興國四年，征幽州，獲其兵立。
Surrendered Ming Feathered Forest: in Taiping Xingguo 4 it was formed from troops captured in the Youzhou campaign.
176
新立清河緣河舊置鋪兵以備河決，後揀閱立。 指揮二。
Newly Established: originally riverside post troops guarding against Qinghe breaches; later formed by review and selection. Two commands.
177
保甯大中祥符元年，馬步軍都虞候王超請以病軍經行陣者立。
Secure Pacification: in Dazhong Xiangfu 1, Cavalry and Infantry Assistant Commander Wang Chao proposed forming sick troops who had already seen battle.
178
新立歸化開寶七年，以江南李從善所領部曲水軍立，八年，平江南，又以降兵增之。 指揮一。
Newly Established Return Submit: in Kaibao 7 it was formed from Jiangnan retainer naval troops under Li Congshan; in Kaibao 8, after Jiangnan was pacified, surrendered troops were added. One command.
179
強壯軍員咸平六年置，指揮一。
Strong Stalwart Corps Members: established in Xianping 6, one command.
180
澄海弩手慶曆二年置，隸海州都巡檢司。 指揮二。 登。 此下至武嚴凡十三軍。
Clear Sea crossbowmen: established in Qingli 2, under the Hai Prefecture overall patrol office. Two commands. Deng. From here through Martial Strict there were thirteen armies in all.
181
捉生延州廂兵，天聖五年升禁軍，指揮二。
Capture Alive: Yan Prefecture Comforter Corps; promoted to Palace Corps in Tiansheng 5, two commands.
182
清邊弩手寶元初，選陝西、河東廂軍之伉健者置，以弩手名。 指揮四十三。 太原九，秦五，涇四，河中、隴各三，永興、代、潞、晉各二，慶、環、滑、同、坊、鎮戎、慈、丹、隰、汾、憲各一。
Clear Border Crossbowmen: at the start of Baoyuan, sturdy Shaanxi and Hedong Comforter Corps were chosen and formed under the crossbowmen title. Forty-three commands. Nine at Taiyuan; five at Qin; four at Jing; three each at Hezhong and Long; two each at Yongxing, Dai, Lu, and Jin; one each at Qing, Huan, Hua, Tong, Fang, Zhenrong, Ci, Dan, Xi, Fen, and Xian.
183
制勝陝西廂兵，慶曆中，升禁軍。 指揮九。 永興、華各二，鳳翔、耀、同、解、乾各一。
Control Victory: Shaanxi Comforter Corps; promoted to Palace Corps during Qingli. Nine commands. Two each at Yongxing and Hua; one each at Fengxiang, Yao, Tong, Jie, and Qian.
184
定功陝西廂軍，慶曆四年，升禁軍增置，爲指揮十。 永興、秦、慶、原、渭、涇、儀、鄜、延、鎮戎各一。
Set Merit: Shaanxi Comforter Corps; in Qingli 4 it was promoted to Palace Corps and expanded to ten commands. One each at Yongxing, Qin, Qing, Yuan, Wei, Jing, Yi, Fu, Yan, and Zhenrong.
185
清澗慶曆初，募土人精悍者充，因其地名。 指揮二。
Clear Stream: at the start of Qingli stalwart local men were recruited, taking the place name. Two commands.
186
建威秦州廂兵，慶曆八年升禁軍。 指揮一。
Establish Prestige: Qin Prefecture Comforter Corps; promoted to Palace Corps in Qingli 8. One command.
187
效勇景祐中，募川峽流民增置，爲指揮二十七。 陳留三，太康、尉氏、襄邑、河陽、曹、合流各二，咸平、鄭、亳、衛、許、單、澶、磁、廣濟、河陰、甯陵、白波各一。
Render Courage: during Jingyou Sichuan gorge refugees were recruited and added, forming twenty-seven commands. Three at Chenliu; two each at Taikang, Weishi, Xiangyi, Heyang, Cao, and Heliu; one each at Xianping, Zheng, Bo, Wei, Xu, Shan, Chan, Ci, Guangji, Heyin, Ningling, and Baibo.
188
宣毅慶曆中，京東、京西、河北、河東、淮南、江南、兩浙、荊湖、福建九路募健勇或選廂軍爲之。 指揮二百八十八，至治平中，管一百七十四。 京東路：南京、鄆、徐、曹、齊各二，青、兗、密、濮、沂、單、濟、淄、萊、濰、登、淮陽、廣濟各一； 京西路：西京、滑、許、河陽、陳、襄、鄭、潁、蔡、汝、隨、信陽各一，鄧二。 河北路：真定、德、棣、博、邢、祁、恩、磁、深、定、濱、通利、永靜、乾寧各一。 河東路：太原、汾各六，晉四，澤、絳、石、代各三，潞、嵐、忻、遼、威勝、平定各二，慈、隰、寧化各一。 淮南路：揚、亳各二，廬、宿、壽、楚、真、泗、蘄海、舒、泰、濠、和、光、黃、通、無爲、高郵、漣水各一。 江南路：江甯、洪、虔、吉、撫、袁、筠、建昌、南安各一。 兩浙路：杭二，越、蘇、明、湖、婺、潤、溫、衢、常、秀、處各一。 荊湖路：潭、全、鼎各三，荊南、邵、衡、永、郴、道、安、鄂、岳、澧、復、峽、歸、辰、荊門、漢陽、桂陽各一。 福建路：建二，泉、南劍、漳、汀、邵武、興化各一。
Proclaim Perseverance: during Qingli the nine routes—Jingdong, Jingxi, Hebei, Hedong, Huainan, Jiangnan, Two Zhe, Jinghu, and Fujian—recruited able men or selected Comforter Corps for the command. Two hundred eighty-eight commands were authorized; by the Zhiping era one hundred seventy-four were on the rolls. Jingdong Route: two each at Nanjing, Yun, Xu, Cao, and Qi; one each at Qing, Yan, Mi, Pu, Yi, Shan, Ji, Zi, Lai, Wei, Deng, Huaiyang, and Guangji; Jingxi Route: one each at Western Capital, Hua, Xu, Heyang, Chen, Xiang, Zheng, Ying, Cai, Ru, Sui, and Xinyang; two at Deng. Hebei Route: one each at Zhending, De, Di, Bo, Xing, Qi, En, Ci, Shen, Ding, Bin, Tongli, Yongjing, and Qianning. Hedong Route: six each at Taiyuan and Fen; four at Jin; three each at Ze, Jiang, Shi, and Dai; two each at Lu, Lan, Xin, Liao, Weisheng, and Pingding; one each at Ci, Xi, and Ninghua. Huainan Route: two each at Yang and Bo; one each at Lu, Su, Shou, Chu, Zhen, Si, Qihai, Shu, Tai, Hao, He, Guang, Huang, Tong, Wuwei, Gaoyou, and Lianshui. Jiangnan Route: one each at Jiangning, Hong, Qian, Ji, Fu, Yuan, Yun, Jianchang, and Nan'an. Two Zhe Route: two at Hang; one each at Yue, Su, Ming, Hu, Wu, Run, Wen, Qu, Chang, Xiu, and Chu. Jinghu Route: three each at Tan, Quan, and Ding; one each at Jingnan, Shao, Heng, Yong, Chen, Dao, An, E, Yue, Li, Fu, Xia, Gui, Shen, Jingmen, Hanyang, and Guiyang. Fujian Route: two at Jian; one each at Quan, Nanjian, Zhang, Ting, Shaowu, and Xinghua.
189
宣毅床子弩炮手慶曆中置。 指揮一。 岢嵐。
Proclaim Perseverance bed crossbow artillerymen: established during Qingli. One command. Kelan.
190
建安府州廂兵，慶曆二年升禁軍。 指揮二。 府、嵐各一。
Jian'an: Fu and Lan prefecture Comforter Corps; promoted to Palace Corps in Qingli 2. Two commands. One each at Fu and Lan.
191
威果嘉祐四年置，指揮二十五。 荊南、江甯、杭、揚、廬、潭各三，洪、越、福各二，虔一。
Awesome Fruit: established in Jiayou 4, twenty-five commands. Three each at Jingnan, Jiangning, Hang, Yang, Lu, and Tan; two each at Hong, Yue, and Fu; one at Qian.
192
武嚴指揮一。 京師。
Martial Strict: one command. Capital.
193
御前忠佐軍頭司馬步軍都軍頭、副都軍頭，馬軍都軍頭、副都軍頭，步軍都軍頭、副都軍頭。 其所轄散員，有副指揮使、軍使、副兵馬使、十將。 馬步直自指揮使而下，皆如殿前司之制。
Bureau of Loyal Assistants before the Throne Army Head: overall and deputy overall army heads for combined horse and foot, cavalry, and infantry. Its Loose Members included deputy commanders, army commissioners, deputy horse-and-foot commissioners, and squad leaders of ten. Horse-and-foot Direct ranks, from commanders down, followed Palace Front Bureau regulations.
194
御前忠佐散員本許州員僚剩員，淳化中，立爲軍頭司散員一班。 又五代以來，軍校立功無可門署者，第令與諸校同其飲膳，名健飯都指揮使，後唯被譴者居此。 大中祥符二年，改爲散指揮使。 班一。
Loyal Assistants before the Throne Loose Members were originally Xu Prefecture Officer Surplus Members; in Chunhua they became one Loose Members squad under the Army Head Bureau. Since the Five Dynasties, officers who earned merit but had no post to receive were given only the same rations as other officers—the title Healthy Meal Overall Commander; later only censured officers held it. In Dazhong Xiangfu 2 the title was changed to Loose Commander. One squad.
195
馬直雍熙四年置，指揮一。
Horse Direct: established in Yongxi 4, one command.
196
步直端拱元年置，指揮一。
Foot Direct: established in Duangong 1, one command.
197
備軍一千九百六十人。
Reserve Corps: one thousand nine hundred sixty men.
198
皇城司親從官太平興國四年，分親事官之有材勇者爲之，給諸殿灑掃及契勘巡察之事。 指揮三。
Imperial City Bureau Personal Attendant Officials: in Taiping Xingguo 4 able personal service officials were set apart for hall sweeping and audit patrol duty. Three commands.
199
入內院子天聖元年，揀親事官年高者爲之。 九年，選輦官六十以上者充。 治平二年，詔以五百人爲額。
Inner Palace Courtyard: In Tiansheng 1, older Personal Attendant Officials were chosen for this duty. In year 9, carriage officials aged sixty or above were appointed. In Zhiping 2, an edict fixed the quota at five hundred men.
200
騏驥院騎御馬直太平興國二年置，分左右番。 八年，分爲二直。 其後增置八直。
Fine Steeds Office Imperial Mount Direct was established in Taiping Xingguo 2 and divided into left and right watches. In year 8, it was split into two Direct companies. Later eight more Direct companies were added.
201
左右教駿舊名左右備征，建隆二年改。 指揮四。
Left and Right Training Steeds were formerly Left and Right Campaign Reserve; they were renamed in Jianlong 2. Four commands.
